broker_name.description: Unique name for this broker instance; used in JMX and cluster identification

data_directory.description: Root directory for all broker data (includes KahaDB, logs, etc.)

enable_jmx.description: Enable JMX management (default is true in ActiveMQ core)

enable_statistics.description: Enable statistics collection (required for JMX metrics and web console)

enable_plug_ins.description: Enable external plugins (e.g., spring-based plugins) — list must be provided

jmx_port.description: Port for JMX RMI connector server (local only by default)

jmx_domain.description: JMX domain name used for MBean registration

kahadb_directory.description: Directory where KahaDB journal, index, and data files are stored

kahadb_journal_max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) of each journal file before rotation

kahadb_index_cache_size.description: Number of index entries cached in memory

memory_usage_percent_of_jvm.description: Percentage of JVM heap to allocate to ActiveMQ memory usage (0–100)

store_usage_limit_gb.description: Maximum disk space (GB) for persistent message storage

temp_usage_limit_gb.description: Maximum disk space (GB) for temporary files (e.g., large messages, streaming)
